parameters.subject: 🚨 [TrendAI] OpenClaw Gateway Crashed — Tristan-Yoga
parameters.message:
=Hi Tai,

This is an automated alert from your TrendAI infrastructure.

SERVICE ALERT — OPENCLAW GATEWAY
─────────────────────────────────
Host:     {{ $json.body.host }}
Service:  {{ $json.body.service }}
Event:    {{ $json.body.event }}
Time:     {{ $json.body.time }}
Message:  {{ $json.body.message }}
Action:   Auto-restart initiated

The OpenClaw gateway process crashed unexpectedly. Systemd has automatically attempted to restart the service.

WHAT TO DO
─────────────────────────────────
1. Check service status:
   journalctl --user -u openclaw-gateway.service -n 50

2. If still down, restart manually:
   systemctl --user restart openclaw-gateway.service

3. If issues persist, check system resources:
   free -h && df -h

─────────────────────────────────
TrendAI Infrastructure Monitoring
Automated alert — do not reply to this email
